note: Week 6 Hurts warning retired from display: predates and is superseded by the Oct 19 joint statement (DVT + bilateral PE, out indefinitely). Week 6 games are final.

warnings.detail: Eagles announced Thursday that Hurts will miss Sunday due to a superficial calf blood clot. No verified return date. Tanner McKee is in line to start.
warnings.forecast_warning: The Oct15 4:30PM injury experiment predates this news and is stale for current CAR-PHI availability. Frozen baseline is scores-only and not QB-adjusted. Do not use either as a current injury-adjusted forecast. No guessed QB point delta or medical prognosis has been applied.
